title: Moonwarden — Solo-built multiplayer web game about cute slimes and betrayal. Looking for honest beta feedback!
author: National_Cut_7565
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

It's been a while, and Moonwarden has gotten better! 🌿✨

I've been working on improving the game, polishing the experience, and making the multiplayer gameplay more enjoyable.

If you've played the beta before, I'd love for you to come back and see what's changed! And if you're new here, this is the perfect time to jump into the magical forest, meet some cute slimes, and discover which friends you can actually trust. 👀

No downloads needed. Moonwarden runs directly in your browser!

🌙 Play Moonwarden: [https://moonwarden-two.vercel.app/](https://moonwarden-two.vercel.app/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

💬 Share your feedback: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1w5tvAa2DykM4CWy7kUpVOpYmm7OGlPlj\_eCdIM979ts](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1w5tvAa2DykM4CWy7kUpVOpYmm7OGlPlj_eCdIM979ts?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'm still an indie solo developer, and every bit of feedback helps me make Moonwarden better.

Whether it's gameplay, bugs, suggestions, or just your overall experience, I'd love to hear from you!

Thanks to everyone who has supported the project so far. It means a lot. ❤️

See you in the forest, Wardens! 🌲
